acceptanceCriteria: The owner decides; if accepted, a symlinked workspace folder runs commands against the resolved root with a test.
body: Found by the 2026-09-27 adapter audit for rc.2. extensions/vscode/src/extension.ts:651-657 fails ROOT_UNSUPPORTED when realpath(root) differs from the lexical path, so a folder opened via a symlinked path (common with ~/src -> /Volumes/...) cannot use any command. The CLI itself accepts the resolved root. Decide whether to resolve and continue with the real path.
title: VS Code rejects workspace folders opened through a symlink
